MIND. [1] [Con.]
Extremely insensible.
Weak memory. θ Vertigo.
Memory enfeebled, likewise the power of correctly expressing one's self ; difficult comprehension.
Forgetfulness ; excessive difficulty of recollecting things, particularly dates.
Dulness, like stupefaction, difficulty in understanding what he reads.
Inability to sustain any mental effort.
Tired, weary sensation in brain, with physical as well as nervous prostration.
Insanity of a periodical or alternating type.
Inclined to cry, sobs aloud when alone.
Likes to wear his best clothes, makes useless purchases, cares very little for things, wastes or ruins them ; does not want to work, prefers to play.
Picks his nose, which bleeds easily ; or picks his fingers ; lies in bed most of the time ; does not like to answer questions.
Dislike to society and yet a dread to be alone. θ Hysteria.
He is averse to being near people, and to the talk of those passing him ; is inclined to seize hold of and abuse them.
Patient averse to talking, dressing himself, taking food or seeing her children ; spleen enlarged. θ Melancholia.
Disinclination for business.
Complete indifference ; takes no interest in anything, particularly walking in open air. θ Hypochondriasis.
Great depression of spirits preceding menstrual period.
Alternate fits of silent depression and quarrelsome liveliness. θ Mania.
Sad and gloomy for days, then excited.
Great unhappiness of mind, recurring every fourteen days.
Easily disturbed by trifles, moved to tears ; anxious.
Hypochondriasis and hysteria from suppression of, or too free indulgence in, sexual instinct, with low-spiritedness, anxiety and sadness.
Hypochondriasis with suppression of menses.
Great anxiety ; precordial anguish ; superstitious and full of fear, with frequent thoughts of death ; loss of memory.
Timid, cannot be persuaded to work ; want of proper will.
Irritable, gets out of temper easily, and then his sight gets blurred, and face becomes pale. θ Anemia of brain.
Very ill-humored in afternoon, from 5 to 6, as though a great grief weighed upon him, with paralyzed feeling in all the limbs, indifference and taking no interest in anything.
Morose mood ; everything about him impresses him unpleasantly.
She feels peevish, vexed and easily put out about trifles.
Cannot endure any kind of excitement, it brings on physical and mental depression, with weakness.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Con.]
Delirium and unconsciousness.
Confused feeling in head, often sits lost in thought.
Constant confusion in forehead in region of eyebrows and root of nose.
Cannot count up anything ; vertigo, < from stooping. θ Uterine disorder.
The slightest spirituous drink intoxicates him.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Con.]
Heaviness in head.
Pain sometimes shoots over to front of head, with sensation as if something like a fringe was falling down over eyes. θ Uterine disorder.
Throbbing from forehead to occiput.
Stitches in top of head.
Scorching on top of head ; hot spots on back of head, > by going out into open air, and by cold water, < from excitement or overwork. θ Uterine disorder.
Lancinating pains, especially in vertex.
After overstudy : feeling at times of a foreign body under skull, in vertex ; > during reading, < after ; < on going to sleep, or from excitement or thinking of pain ; > by touch ; relief during reading seems to rise from diversion of mind from the pain ; clicking noise in left vertex on walking and during stool ; also in occiput on walking, especially in evening when tired.
Pain in occiput, with every pulse, as if pierced with a knife.
Heaviness in occiput on bending head forward ; vertigo.
Sensation in right half of brain as of a large foreign body.
Numbness, with sensation of coldness one side of head.
Tearing in head, must lie down ; one-sided.
Headache as if head was too full and would burst ; morning when awaking.
Tearing headache, with nausea.
Sick headaches, with inability to urinate ; great giddiness, < lying in bed, when everything in room seems to go round.
Chronic stitching headache.
Headache : caused by too small but frequent stools, with tenesmus ; with pains all over chest ; during violent coughing fits ; < from least noise, during motion and from a sudden jar or shock.
Congestion to head, with catarrhal sensation and heat of face.
Hydrocephalus : pains < when awaking, after eating, in open air ; > by external pressure, lying down, and closing eyes.
Inflammation of brain in children.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Con.]
Objects look red ; rainbow colored ; striped, confused spots.
Black spots before eyes with vertigo. θ Dysentery.
Sensation as if something like a fringe was falling over eyes.
Double vision.
Weakness of sight ; amaurosis.
Shortsighted ; asthenopia.
Cannot read long without letters running together ; burning pain deep in eyes, with hot flushes, cannot bear either light or heat ; < in a warm room ; > in mornings and on a cloudy day ; black spots are seen on closing eyes ; distant objects appear more distant ; objects are surrounded by prismatic colors out of doors ; eyes perfectly normal in appearance ; asthenopia.
Sluggish adaptation of eye to varied range of vision.
Near objects are seen indistinctly.
Vision becomes blurred when he is irritable. θ Anemia of brain.
Weakness and dazzling of eyes, together with dizziness, and debility, especially of arms and legs ; on walking, staggering as if drunk.
Aversion to light, without inflammation of eyes.
Intense photophobia of both eyes, with which were associated particularly in left eye, redness of sclerotic, dimness of cornea, swelling and redness of eyelids, great increase of secretion of mucus and tears ; scrofulous constitution.
Photophobia, with profuse flow of tears when eyes are forcibly opened ; very slight or no redness ; pains < at night and in any light ; > in a dark room and by pressure.
Severe photophobia and lachrymation ; borders of eyelids red and swollen ; ulcers on cornea near sclerotic where there is great vascularity ; catamenia irregular.
Photophobia of strumous ophthalmia.
Conjunctival vessels injected from inner canthus of eye to margin of cornea, which appears dull and depressed in centre ; pressing pain in eyeball ; < from light ; sensation as if eyeball was swollen ; swelling of cheek and lids of affected side ; twitchings ; lachrymation ; ulcers ; tearing pain in right side of head. θ Traumatic inflammation.
Keratitis punctata, with great photophobia.
Pupils dilated.
Cataract from contusion ; grey cataract.
Scrofulous ophthalmia ; sluggish cases, not much injection but excessive photophobia.
Inflammatory conditions of cornea (ulcers and pustules), especially if inflammation is superficial, involving only the epithelial layers, and whether caused by an injury, cold, or more frequently, a scrofulous diathesis.
Ulcers on cornea, right to left.
Right eye bloodshot ; aches on lying down to sleep ; agglutination in morning, also lachrymation.
Burning of eyes.
Eyes feel as if pulled outward from nose (external rectus muscle) ; photophobia ; vertical pain in head, < in open air ; must often leave school on account of a sensation of overpowering giddiness coming over her ; farsighted.
Shooting, smarting, itching in inner canthus, with lachrymation.
Induration of lids ; ptosis.
Upper lids swollen to such an extent as to completely cover the lower ones, swelling also extends above eyebrows ; lids pale red, shining, with a doughy feel and sensitive to slightest touch ; margin of lids bluish-red and indurated ; on attempting to open lids, the puffed, dark red conjunctiva palpebrarum tilts forward in a swollen mass ; conjunctiva oculi not much inflamed ; cornea clear ; great photophobia ; discharge of thin yellow pus ; lachrymation ; burning, stinging pain, < at night ; patient scrofulous.
Lids only opened with great difficulty, and when done, a flood of hot tears spurts out.
Could scarcely raise eyelids, they seemed pressed down by a heavy weight ; disposed to fall asleep.
Burning on inner surface of lids.
Hordeola where the trouble recurs ; several hordeola become indurated, and on occasion inflame again.
Blennorrhœa of lachrymal sac.
Itching below eyes and smarting, burning when rubbing them.
Eyes have a leaden hue. θ Morning sickness.
Paralysis of optic nerve ; amaurosis.
Hyperesthesia of retina.
Paralysis of muscles.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Con.]
Painful sensitiveness of hearing ; noise startles, deafness follows.
Ringing, singing, humming, buzzing and roaring in ears.
Obstruction of ears ; feel stopped up, when blowing nose.
Hardness of hearing.
Drawing stitching in ear from within outward.
Tearing and stitching in and about ears.
Pinching pain in right ear. θ Uterine disorder.
Hardness of hearing, ceasing when wax is removed, returning as wax again accumulates.
Accumulation of earwax, looking blood red, or like decayed paper, with pus or mucus.
Tumors and boils behind ears.
Parotid glands swollen and hard.
Suppuration of left parotid with profuse sweat, disturbing sleep. θ Diabetes.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Con.]
Excessively acute sense of smell.
Constantly picks his nose, which bleeds easily. θ Mental derangement.
Stinging soreness and itching at tip and inside of nose.
Pain deep in root of nose before menses, < from panting or pressure ; discharge of blood and pus from nose.
Ozæna, with burning in nostrils and stitching pain in nasal septum, discharge of pus and blood from nose ; after abuse of mercury.
Fluent coryza. θ Cough.
Flow of acrid mucus from nose. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Purulent discharge from nose ; also hardened crusts.
Epistaxis.
Nosebleed : with suppressed menses, from taking cold ; frequent ebullitions of blood ; from slightest cause ; in Spring ; after sneezing.
Frequent excessive sneezing.
Obstruction of nostrils of long standing.
Inflammation of nose with bleeding from right side, after abuse of mercury.
Fibrous polypi, hard and elastic, pricking and itching after touching or handling ; excessively acute smell, with purulent discharge.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Con.]
Face flushed. θ Whooping cough.
Drawing, extending from jaws to ears and head.
Stinging tearing faceache, at night.
Itching pimples in face.
Gnawing ulcers in face, or moist and spreading herpes.
Eruption of small and large pustules on right cheek. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Ulcers on face and lips ; cancer of cheek ; spreading cancerous ulcers ; cancerous tumors of lips and face.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Con.]
Lips and teeth covered with black crusts.
Blisters, or eruption on lips.
Induration of lymphatics of lip after contusion.
Cancer of lips ; from pressure of pipe.
Submaxillary glands swollen and hard.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Con.]
Jerking pain in teeth ; seem loose during mastication.
Violent drawing toothache ; teeth feel loose.
Drawing in a hollow tooth, when eating cold things or from cold drink.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Con.]
Speech difficult ; distortion of tongue and mouth.
Tongue swollen, painful, stiff.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Con.]
Constant inclination to swallow ; involuntary swallowing, especially when walking in wind.
Strange rising in throat, with sense of stuffing, as if something was lodged there.
Sense of fulness in throat as of a lump, with involuntary attempts at swallowing.
Fulness in pit of throat, with suppressed eructations.
Pressure in œsophagus as if a round body was ascending from stomach. θ Globus hystericus.
Bitterness in throat.
Spasmodic constriction of throat.
Itching in throat, with irritation to a hacking cough.
Excruciating pains in throat. θ Uterine polypi.
Exudation dirty greyish. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Con.]
Loss of appetite. θ Morning sickness.
Appetite very poor, but with a strong craving for salt things. θ Chronic dysentery.
Appetite very poor, no thirst. θ Uterine disorder.
Craves coffee, salt, or sour things.
Thirst. θ Ophthalmia.
Thirst, with internal heat, or burning heat through whole body.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Con.]
Sour rising from stomach, after eating.
After taking a small quantity of milk, sudden distension of abdomen.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Con.]
Sour rising of food. θ Suppressed menses.
Sour belching, < at night. θ Marasmus.
Nausea : frequent ; with tearing headache ; after eating ; of pregnant women.
Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy ; slimy, watery.
She wakes in morning very sick at stomach and vomits several times from 5 o'clock until breakfast ; substance vomited is white and frothy, followed by something yellow, like bile ; vomits several times during day.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Con.]
Aching and pressure in epigastrium ; it extends from epigastrium up to pharynx, and feels as if a ball was rising to throat.
Sense of fulness and repletion in stomach.
Violent pains in stomach, always two or three hours after eating, but also at night ; somewhat > in knee-elbow position.
Swelling in region of pylorus.
Pressing, burning, squeezing pain, extending from pit of stomach into back and shoulders.
Pressure and sore raw feeling at pit of stomach.
Spasm of stomach.
Cramps in stomach with tendency to constipation, especially in those of lymphatic temperament.
Spasms in pit of stomach extending from right to left, also to back, coming on in paroxysms ; before attack cramp in calves ; pyrosis ; throbbing in forehead to occiput.
Painful spasm of stomach, feeling as if stomach contracted, or of a heavy burden upon stomach ; she cannot bear tight clothing ; pain never entirely ceased, but was sometimes moderate, and then gradually became very severe ; tendency to constipation ; wearisome, spasmodic cough which < gastralgia ; cough < by talking, running, and by emotion.
Cancer of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Con.]
Painful tension about hypochondria as from a constricting band.
Pressive, tensive pain in hypochondria ; stitching pains in hepatic region ; excessive colicky pains.
Stitches or painful tearing in hepatic region.
Pain in liver with accumulation of earwax.
Pressing pain in right hypochondriac region, < from pressure, convex, hard swelling, extending towards precordial region and nearly to right crest of ilium. θ Enlargement of liver.
Constant pain in liver, with hardness and œdema. θ Uterine polypi.
Hard swelling of liver.
Enlargement of spleen. θ Melancholia.
Sudden attack of vomiting and diarrhœa at night ; vomiting of a white substance consisting of saliva without any admixture of contents of either stomach or bowels ; gouty diathesis. θ Acute inflammation of pancreas.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Con.]
Trembling of whole abdomen.
Fulness and bearing down in abdomen. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Inflation of abdomen after meals, particularly after milk.
Swelling of abdomen.
Hardness of abdomen from swelling of mesenteric glands.
Sensation as if he must take hold of abdomen when coughing ; feels as if cough came from there. θ Anemia of brain.
Great sensitiveness of abdomen and sore feeling.
Stitches extending from abdomen to right side of chest.
Pinching pains in abdomen, as if diarrhœa would set in.
Griping in abdomen before discharge of leucorrhœa.
Colic from incarcerated flatus.
Cutting in abdomen before emission of flatus.
Contractive pain in lower abdomen, like after-pains, with urging to stool.
Constrictive pains in lower part of abdomen.
Pain in hypogastric region during menses, going down legs.
Aching pain in hypogastric region, like menstrual colic.
Forcing down feeling in hypogastric region, like menstrual labor pains.
Bearing down pain and burning in hypogastric region. θ Uterine derangement.
Tumors in abdomen.
Enlargement of mesenteric glands.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Con.]
Involuntary discharge of feces during sleep.
Diarrhœa. θ Vertigo.
Frequent diarrhœa and copious urination.
Slime, mixed with greenish substances and containing bloody specks ; stools are very small, offensive, with tenesmus and discharge of flatus during passage, with a weak, trembling feeling after ; no pain at all ; eight to fourteen stools daily, the passages becoming more frequent at night. θ Chronic dysentery.
Stools : liquid, fecal ; mingled with hard lumps ; watery, undigested, and passed with loud emissions of flatus, with colic ; liquid, diarrheic, with colic, discharge of flatus and much mucus or undigested food, or even blood ; undigested, painless ; painful ; hard, with tenesmus ; very debilitating ; frequent and sour ; streaked with blood ; with discharge of blood.
Constipation and diarrhœa alternately. θ Uterine polypi.
Constipation alternating with bilious diarrhœa.
Stools sometimes regular, sometimes hard and tardy, or green and diarrheic. θ Enlargement of liver.
Frequent ineffectual urging to stool ; or small quantity passed each time.
Constipation, with ineffectual desire for stool ; constant urging, without stool.
Stools tardy, hard and dry. θ Cough.
Hard stool, with tenesmus, headache and discharge of prostatic fluid.
Obstinate constipation, no stool for seven days, stools large, hard, and followed by tremulous weakness ; she must lie down. θ Prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Hard stool every other day. θ Mental derangement.
During stool a foreign body protrudes from the vulva. θ Uterine polypi.
After every stool, trembling, weakness and palpitation.
Heat in lower portion of rectum.
Frequent stitches in anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Con.]
Great pain in bladder, constant disposition to urinate, only a few drops passing at a time. θ Morning sickness.
Pain in urethra during micturition. θ Vertigo.
Immediately after urinating, burning in urethra, in morning.
Strangury.
Constant urging to urinate, with heat on urinating.
Frequent micturition at night. θ Mental derangement.
Urine clear as crystal and intermitting in its flow. θ Chronic dysentery.
Intermittent flow of urine with cutting after micturition.
Urine turbid, after standing, dirty grey, with a yellowish tint. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Urine scant, brown or full of sediment, containing bile, with burning on urination. θ Enlarged liver.
Urine feels hot. θ Uterine disorder.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Con.]
Sexual desire without erection.
With weakness of sexual organs, much sexual erethism, amatory thoughts, even emissions provoked by mere presence of women.
Great sexual desire with partial or complete incapacity ; emissions on slightest provocation, melancholy.
Emissions without dreams.
Nightly emissions and spermatorrhœa ; urine flowing and stopping again at each passage of water.
Painful emission of semen.
Excessive pollutions, particularly of young people.
Excessive pollutions, with no history of previous excesses.
Bad effects from suppressed sexual desire, or from excessive indulgence.
Sexual weakness. θ Anemia of brain. θ Mental derangement.
Insufficient erection, lasting only a short time ; feeble embrace ; weakness after an embrace.
Impotence and want of erections.
Swelling and induration of testicles, particularly after contusion.
Cutting pain through scrotum to root of penis ; pressing and tearing pains in testes.
Discharge of prostatic fluid on every change of emotion, without voluptuous thoughts, or while expelling feces ; with itching of prepuce.
Recent cases of gonorrhœa with orchitis and severe nocturnal pains.
Indurated chancre of long standing.
Rheumatism after suppressed gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Con.]
Ill effects of suppressed sexual instinct, or non-gratification of sexual appetite.
Induration and enlargement of ovaries or womb, with lancinating pains.
Indurations, especially of a scrofulous nature or from injuries.
Prolapsus uteri complicated with induration, ulceration and profuse leucorrhœa.
Uterus prolapsed and anteverted ; bearing down as though womb would be forced from vulva ; < when standing and walking, before and during menses ; dysmenorrhœa.
Induration of cervix ; sharp pains in part ; prolapsus uteri ; acrid leucorrhœa ; swelling of breasts ; stitches in breasts mostly at night.
Weight and lancinating pains in womb and ovaries, extending through whole lower part of abdomen, hips and back ; during stool a foreign body protrudes from vulva ; copious and frequent uterine hemorrhages ; leucorrhœa reddish, extremely fetid. θ Uterine polypi.
A grinding pain is felt above pudendum ; the abdomen becomes inflated, the chest is affected and stitches are felt in left side.
Uterine spasm during too early and scanty catamenia, followed by leucorrhœa, with nightly pains, hysterical paroxysms.
Burning, stinging, darting pains in neck of uterus, with indurations and scirrhosities.
Burning, sore, aching sensation in region of uterus.
Before menstruation : anxious dreams ; heat without thirst ; general bruised feeling, with inclination to weep ; restlessness and anxious apprehensiveness ; pains in breasts, with soreness and swelling ; stitches in liver ; distension.
Great soreness of breasts precedes menstruation ; < by least jar or walking.
Amenorrhœa : genitals very sensitive ; complicated with ovarian or uterine disease and chlorosis ; with venous abdominal hyperemia.
During menstruation : great fears when alone, but dread of strangers or company ; labor-like abdominal pains, extending into thigh ; stitches in chest ; headache ; eruption ; stinging pains in neck of uterus.
At every menstrual effort the breasts enlarge, become sore and painful.
Pressure from above downward, and drawing in legs during menses.
Menses too weak.
Menses irregular, three months passing sometimes without appearance of menses, and then they are scanty. θ Inflammation of eyes.
Dysmenorrhœa, with shooting pains in left chest, or sharp pains about heart.
Dysmenorrhœa : pains in hypogastric region and down legs ; sharp pain in back ; chills commencing in breasts ; vertigo in bed, everything turning round ; menses too soon, too profuse, natural in color ; has weak spells.
Catamenia too late, scanty, and of short duration.
Menses : suppressed ; feeble, too late and scanty, of short duration.
Menses scant, clotted, accompanied by rash over whole body of small red pimples, which burn severely when scratched, and disappear with cessation of menstruation.
Menses stopped by taking cold ; putting hands in cold water ; sour rising of food ; urine intermits ; nosebleed.
Every four weeks, great sensitiveness of labia majora and minora ; constant dry heat of body without thirst ; anxious dreams ; heaviness in all the limbs ; tearfulness ; restlessness ; anxious concern about trifles ; stitches in hepatic region, often lasting several days and greatly prostrating her, with entire absence of menstruation.
Leucorrhœa ten days after menses, stopping suddenly and soon flowing again, lasting several days, with much pain in bowels before discharge.
Leucorrhœa : profuse ; bloody, mucous ; excoriating ; thick, milky, with contractive, labor-like colic, coming from both sides ; of white, acrid mucus, causing burning or smarting sensation.
Bearing down and stitches in vagina.
Severe itching deep in vagina.
Indurations of vulva from injuries.
Severe stitches in vulva.
Large pimple on mons veneris, painful to touch.
Shriveling of mamma, without sexual desire.
Fibroid tumors of uterus.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Con.]
Terrible nausea and vomiting during pregnancy.
Wakes in morning sick at stomach, vomiting several times from 5 o'clock till breakfast ; the substance vomited is white and frothy, followed by something yellow, like bile, < from raising head ; vomits several times during day ; three months pregnant.
Aching pain in abdomen during pregnancy ; is disturbed between 12 and 3 o'clock at night by having to get up to urinate ; has no affection for anybody.
Cough during pregnancy, < at night.
Obstinate cramps in stomach during pregnancy ; sensation of constriction, or of a heavy weight pressing upon stomach ; pains are constant but remittent in character, gradually growing so severe as to become unbearable ; constant dry, spasmodic cough which aggravates the cramps ; cough < from speaking, walking, or mental emotions.
Rigidity of os uteri during labor.
During parturition, complete sleeplessness and exhaustion ; can hardly speak a few words ; extreme sensibility to light, shunning the light to such a degree that smallest ray of sunlight causes great anguish.
In first week after delivery, could not move head to turn over in bed on account of great vertigo.
Constant discharge of thin, watery milk from breasts for nine months after child has been weaned.
Induration of right mammary gland during lactation ; burning pain. θ Mastitis.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Con.]
Larynx sensitive to touch. θ Cough.
Dry spot in larynx, where there are crawling and almost constant irritation to cough.
Scraping in larynx, with irritation to cough, and dry cough in evening.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Con.]
Constriction of chest, with dyspnœa. θ Cough.
Oppressed breathing in morning when waking.
Sawing, snoring breathing. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Asthmatic paroxysms come on in wet weather ; face bluish-red.
Asthma in morning when awaking.
Asthma of old people, with tickling cough.
Noise in larynx, which resembles very much an unarticulated "sha-li-sha-li" in sound ; this so disturbing that he must cease going to school ; marked spasmodic twitchings of muscles of right side of face ; these often precede the sounds ; spasmodic pressing pain in region of ligam. glottid. ; noise and twitchings of face < from talking, > by rest and sleep ; patient scrofulous and glands are swollen. θ Affection of inf. laryngeal nerve.
Bronchitis.
   

COUGH. [27] [Con.]
Unbearable titillation in pit of throat, with lisping voice, causing paroxysms of coughing.
Dry, tickling cough after catarrh, spasmodic tickling in larynx, which is very sensitive to touch ; cough recurs every evening at 6 o'clock, lasting several hours, and is very annoying to patient.
Tickling, dry cough, annoying most at night, with violent headache, disturbing sleep ; fluent coryza ; oppression of chest.
Powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough excited by itching and tickling in chest and throat, or by a dry spot in larynx, < at night and when lying down, greatly fatiguing patient.
Dry cough, < towards morning, with constriction and oppression of chest.
Dry, tearing cough, persistent and annoying, < lying down, going out of warm room into air, and changing position in bed at night. θ Anemia of brain.
Cough, when first lying down, during day or evening ; is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Cough very much < by lying down ; in beginning many shocks of coughing as if he would vomit ; constant severe cough in evening on going to sleep.
Cough, wakes frequently at night out of a restless sleep, with stitching pains in sides of chest.
Chronic cough from enlargement of bronchial glands, or irritation of laryngeal lining ; dry, hacking, laryngeal cough.
Lying down and taking a deep breath cause cough.
Sensation when coughing as if he must take hold of abdomen, feels as if cough proceeded from there. θ Anemia of brain.
After influenza : cough coming with no regularity, but more frequent at night than at any other time and continuing until retching and vomiting occur, expelling a small quantity of frothy mucus with a yellow nucleus.
Cough : loose, with inability to expectorate ; must swallow what is raised.
Whooping cough if subacute bronchitis has supervened.
Violent cough at night, with influenza.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Oppressive constriction of chest, with dry cough.
Pressure on chest, with spasmodic, tickling night cough.
Sharp thrusts directly through chest, from sternum to spine, while sitting.
Stitches : in right chest about nipple, on every inspiration, while walking, < from hard pressure with hand ; in left side of chest, with uterine spasms ; from abdomen to right side of chest.
Dull pain in left chest, tenth rib, < from coughing. θ Anemia of brain.
Hæmoptysis, or hemorrhage especially after masturbation, with tensive, pressing, stitching pains in chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Con.]
Violent palpitation of heart. θ Morning sickness.
Violent palpitation after drinking, when rising from bed.
Palpitation after stool ; intermissions in beats of heart.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Stitches as with needles in left mamma.
Violent stitches in left side of chest above nipple, on every inspiration while walking, not > by hard pressure of hand.
Violent stitches in right side, as if a knife was plunged into side, causing loud moaning. θ Pneumonia.
Inflammation of breast, with stitches.
Pain in mamma, which often swell and become hard.
Hot pains through left breast and axilla. θ Uterine disorder.
Dull pain below left mamma. θ Prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Hardness of right mamma, with painfulness to touch, and nightly stitches in it.
Mammary induration following abscess of right mammary gland, remaining without change for two years.
Painful swelling of breast, about size of walnut.
Hard and painful lumps in mamma.
Tumor under left nipple as large as a hen's egg, moving freely under superficial fascia, and very hard and painful on pressure ; nipple inverted and sensitive to touch ; stinging, twinging pains ; leaden cast of areola.
Small and painless tumor in breast near nipple.
Tumors in mamma, with piercing pains, < at night, gland abnormally tender.
From contusion, hard lump as large as walnut on right side of nipple of right breast ; constant, dull, heavy pain in breast ; at night after spot has been irritated in any way, sharp and shooting pains.
After contusion of right breast, an uneven swelling, hard as stone, supporting a rough, wart-like, humid elevation ; axillary glands swollen ; fever in evening ; dull stitches in breast.
Hard, scirrhous-like tumors.
Stony-hard scirrhus of breast, sharp, shooting pains and occasional twinges.
Scirrhus in mamma, hard as cartilage and uneven, which had grown during climacteric period to size of hen's egg.
Scirrhous cancer of breast, stony, hard, large as teacup ; pains shooting ; sense of great heaviness in breast.
Scirrhus of left breast ; occasionally twitching in affected part, rarely pain ; the mass is immovable, and skin covering it not discolored.
Hypertrophy of breast, either general or lobular, followed by atrophy.
Wasting of breasts ; complete atrophy of mammary gland, leaving a flaccid, baglike skin.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Con.]
Pain as from a sprain in left side of back and neck.
Enormously enlarged cervical glands. θ Caries lower jaw.
Cervical glands hard and tender.
Indurated and swollen cervical glands in scrofulous children.
Neck twisted by hard swelling to right shoulder. θ After scarlatina.
Herpetic eruption on neck and behind ears, < from heat, which causes a burning sensation.
Dragging pain in small of back. θ Uterine disorder.
Stitches in small of back, with drawing through lumbar vertebræ, while standing.
Sharp pains in back, with chills. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Dorsal pain between shoulders and in lumbar region.
Peculiar tumor in central part of back, as large as a cherry, growing on half an inch long pedicle ; tumor and pedicle of a bluish color.
Lancinating pains and weight in back, hips and lower part of abdomen, extending from womb and ovaries. θ Uterine polypi.
After falling from a height upon back, acute pain in lower part and in region of small of back, especially when laughing, sneezing, or taking a quick breath.
Ill effects of bruises and shocks to spine.
Coccyodynia.
Upon buttocks small, scattered, flat, wart-like, greyish-brown growths of hypertrophied epidermis. θ Enlargement of liver.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Con.]
Shoulders feel bruised and sore.
Axillary glands swollen. θ Mammary tumor.
Arms when lifted fall like inert masses and remain immovable.
Ichorous, biting, burning herpes on hands and forearms.
Cracking in wrist joint.
Itching on dorsum of finger.
Yellow nails.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Con.]
Sensation of weakness even to trembling, in right thigh while walking.
Staggering gait.
Pain in knee as from fatigue.
Herpetic eruption over popliteal space.
Pain going from hypogastric region down legs. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Cracking of knee joint.
Cramps of calves.
Red spots on calves, turning yellow or green, as from contusion, preventing movement.
Liability of feet to catch cold from slight exposure.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Con.]
Heaviness and sense of weariness in all limbs.
Paralyzed feeling in all limbs.
Difficulty in using limbs ; unable to walk.
Unpainful lameness ; trembling of limbs.
Shooting pains through arms and legs. θ Uterine disorder.
Paralysis of lower, afterward of upper extremities, or the reverse.
Numbness of fingers and toes, the former looking as if they were dead.
All the joints pain as if beaten.
Piercing and tearing pains through extremities and in joints, particularly in elbows and hip joints.
   

NERVES. [36] [Con.]
Very easily overstrained.
Weak spells. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Great physical and mental debility.
Great prostration of nervous and muscular systems, < from excitement. θ Anemia of brain.
Exhausted, faint, and as if paralyzed after a short walk.
Sudden loss of strength while walking.
Complete sleeplessness and exhaustion, can hardly speak a few words.
Faintness ; sick and faint early in morning in bed, or after stool.
Tremulous weakness after every stool, > in open air.
Trembling of all the limbs ; muscular tremor.
Hysteria ; globus hystericus.
Paroxysms of hysteria and hypochondriasis from abstinence from sexual intercourse.
Hysterical spasms, convulsions.
Frequent attacks of an apoplectic nature ; headache and fainting. θ Uterine polypi.
Muscular paralysis without spasms.
General spinal paralysis and that which follows diphtheria.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Con.]
Drowsiness by day, stupid in morning. θ Vertigo.
Somnolence, with constant waking and change of position, sawing snoring breathing ; condition < at night. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Stupor-like, unrefreshing sleep, broken by heavy dreams.
Very restless sleep. θ Mental derangement.
Cough disturbing sleep.
Falls asleep late, after midnight.
Complete sleeplessness and exhaustion. θ Photophobia.
Five minutes after falling asleep wakes up bathed in sweat, most profuse on head and upper portion of body. θ Diabetes with parotitis.
Nocturnal pains in ulcers prevent sleep.
Awakes from sleep with fright and start on account of a cracking in head.
Dreams frightful.
Sleep disturbed by nightmares. θ Anemia of brain.
   

FEVER. [40] [Con.]
Chill and coldness in morning and afternoon (3 to 5 o'clock).
Chill, with continuous desire for warmth, particularly that of sun.
Chilliness along whole of back. θ Anemia of brain.
Internal chill in morning ; with shivering in afternoon.
Chills during pains, commencing in breasts. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Heat, with thirst and redness of face.
Great heat, internal and external, with great nervousness.
Skin hot, burning at night in bed. θ Anemia of brain.
Internal heat, with thirst.
Catarrhal fever.
Burning heat through whole body, with thirst.
Sweat on head, face and neck. θ Ophthalmia.
Sweat day and night, as soon as one sleeps, or even when closing eyes.
Night and morning sweat, with offensive odor and smarting in skin, or offensive odor without perspiration.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Con.]
Great liability to take cold.
Swelling and induration of glands, with tingling and stitches ; after contusions and bruises.
   

SKIN. [46] [Con.]
Yellow color of skin ; jaundice.
Yellow spots on fingers ; yellow nails.
Brown spots upon body.
Erratic itching of all parts of body, as from fleas.
Itching on dorsum of finger.
Urticaria, from violent bodily exercise.
Sudden herpetic eruption on forearm, beginning as a small spot and gradually spreading over arm ; skin red, swollen and corrugated, lymph or blood oozing from broken places in skin, lymph drying and forming white crusts under which the exudation still continues ; intense itching in affected parts, with irresistible desire to scratch, particularly in evening ; surrounding lymphatics swollen and involved.
Herpetic eruption forming into scabs as large as hand in various parts of body.
Sero-purulent eruption in aged people, and hypochondriacal old maids.
Petechia in old persons.
Tumor can be traced to a bruise ; lancinating pains.
Blackish ulcers, with bloody, fetid, ichorous discharges, especially after contusions.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Con.]
Suited to women of rigid fibre, easily excited, as well as to those of opposite temperament.
Scrofulous constitutions ; strumous condition, enlarged glands.
Apoplectic paralysis.
